value.title: Why Change Management Matters
value.script: Change initiatives fail at an alarming rate — not because the strategy is wrong, but because people aren't brought along for the journey. As a manager, you're on the front line of every change your organisation undertakes. The ADKAR framework gives you a structured way to guide your team through change successfully.

value.title: The Five Elements of ADKAR
value.script: ADKAR stands for five essential elements. Awareness — people need to understand why the change is necessary. Desire — they must want to support and participate in the change. Knowledge — they need to know how to change. Ability — they must be able to implement the change in their day-to-day work. And Reinforcement — the change must be sustained over time. As a manager, your role spans all five. You build awareness through communication, foster desire through coaching, and reinforce change through recognition and accountability.
